values: Use this workbook for a reviewed, server-authorised inventory import. The app previews every row before any stock changes.
Choose a category and unit from the controlled lists.
Categories and units are validated by Yorks before commit.
Opening Balance, Add Stock, Remove Stock, Correction (+), Correction (-), or No Stock Change.
For Opening Balance, enter the explicit cutoff date in the app review step.
The app will not infer a cutoff date from this workbook.
External Supplier Name may be blank.
Blank, Unknown, N/A and Unknown Supplier resolve to the protected Unknown Supplier folder.
For Add Stock from an external supplier, provide a delivery note/reference and received date.
These values establish supplier receipt evidence.
Notes are optional, except for Remove Stock and Corrections.
For those actions, Notes provides the audit reason.
Yorks derives the internal source from Stock Action and preserves raw workbook evidence.
Leave Serial No blank when the manufacturer serial is not known. Use one row with quantity 1 for each real serial.
N/A, Unknown and dashes are treated as no serial by the app. Yorks never invents a manufacturer serial.
